defmodule ReadaloudAudiobook.GenerateJob do
  use Oban.Worker, queue: :tts, max_attempts: 3

  alias ReadaloudAudiobook.{AudiobookTask, ChapterAudio, Loudness, TimingAligner}
  alias ReadaloudLibrary.{Repo, Tasks}
  alias ReadaloudTTS.{TextChunker, Voice}

  require Logger

  @impl Oban.Worker
  def perform(%Oban.Job{args: %{"task_id" => task_id}} = job) do
    task = Repo.get!(AudiobookTask, task_id)

    # Every log line from this job (including TTS provider warnings further
    # down the stack) carries the task/book/chapter, so a stuck generation
    # can be traced end-to-end in Loki.
    Logger.metadata(task_id: task.id, book_id: task.book_id, chapter_id: task.chapter_id)

    # Crash recovery: a still-:processing row means the previous run was killed
    # by a restart. Compensate Oban's attempt counter so crashes don't burn
    # real attempts — only genuine TTS failures should count.
    if Tasks.processing?(task) do
      import Ecto.Query

      from(j in "oban_jobs", where: j.id == ^job.id)
      |> Repo.update_all(inc: [max_attempts: 1])
    end

    {:ok, task} = Tasks.start(task)

    chapter = ReadaloudLibrary.get_chapter!(task.chapter_id)
    voice = %Voice{model: task.model, voice: task.voice, speed: task.speed || 1.0}
    started = System.monotonic_time()

    with {:ok, text} <- ReadaloudLibrary.get_chapter_content(chapter),
         clean_text = strip_html(text),
         chunks = TextChunker.chunk(clean_text, ReadaloudTTS.max_chunk_chars(voice)),
         :ok <- ensure_non_empty(chunks),
         {:ok, audio, chunk_timings} <- synthesize_chunks(chunks, voice, task) do
      audio_path = audio_storage_path(chapter)
      File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(audio_path))
      File.write!(audio_path, audio)

      # Final alignment pass: reconcile per-chunk timings with full source text
      timings = TimingAligner.align(chunk_timings, clean_text)

      %ChapterAudio{}
      |> ChapterAudio.changeset(%{
        chapter_id: chapter.id,
        audio_path: audio_path,
        duration_seconds: calculate_duration(audio),
        word_timings: Jason.encode!(timings),
        model: task.model,
        voice: task.voice
      })
      |> Repo.insert!(on_conflict: :replace_all, conflict_target: :chapter_id)

      {:ok, _task} = Tasks.complete(task)

      emit_chapter_stop(started, "ok", %{
        chunks: length(chunks),
        audio_seconds: calculate_duration(audio)
      })

      :ok
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:ok, _task} = Tasks.fail(task, "#{inspect(reason)}")
        emit_chapter_stop(started, "error", %{})
        {:error, reason}
    end
  rescue
    exception ->
      # Prevent zombie tasks: ensure transition to :failed even on unexpected
      # exceptions outside the `with` block. Fresh lookup — task_id is bound
      # from the function head, always safe.
      if failed_task = Repo.get(AudiobookTask, task_id) do
        Tasks.fail(failed_task, "Unexpected error: #{Exception.message(exception)}")
      end

      reraise exception, __STACKTRACE__
  end

  # `started` is monotonic; extra measurements (chunks, audio_seconds) only
  # exist on the ok path. Status is a bounded Prometheus label.
  defp emit_chapter_stop(started, status, extra_measurements) do
    :telemetry.execute(
      [:readaloud, :tts, :chapter, :stop],
      Map.put(extra_measurements, :duration, System.monotonic_time() - started),
      %{status: status}
    )
  end

  # Empty/whitespace-only chapters surface as a hard failure so Oban stops
  # retrying — the upstream LocalAI TTS returns a 500 (`torch.cat()` on empty
  # tensor list) and Req+Oban together used to spin for ~minutes per attempt.
  defp ensure_non_empty([]), do: {:error, :empty_chapter_content}
  defp ensure_non_empty(_chunks), do: :ok

  defp synthesize_chunks(chunks, voice, task) do
    total = length(chunks)
    Logger.info("Synthesizing #{total} chunks for task #{task.id}")

    chunks
    |> Enum.with_index(1)
    |> Enum.reduce_while({:ok, <<>>, [], 0}, fn {chunk, idx},
                                                {:ok, audio_acc, timings_acc, offset_ms} ->
      Logger.info("Chunk #{idx}/#{total}: #{String.length(chunk)} chars")
      chunk_started = System.monotonic_time()

      case ReadaloudTTS.synthesize(chunk, voice) do
        {:ok, chunk_audio} ->
          emit_chunk_stop(chunk_started, "ok")
          # Level before anything else reads the audio, so the stitched
          # chapter has no volume step at the join.
          chunk_audio = Loudness.level(chunk_audio)
          chunk_duration_ms = round(calculate_duration(chunk_audio) * 1000)

          # Transcribe and align to source text
          chunk_timings =
            case ReadaloudTTS.transcribe(chunk_audio) do
              {:ok, t} ->
                aligned = TimingAligner.align(t, chunk)
                # Offset timings by accumulated audio duration
                Enum.map(aligned, fn w ->
                  %{w | start_ms: w.start_ms + offset_ms, end_ms: w.end_ms + offset_ms}
                end)

              {:error, reason} ->
                Logger.warning("Transcription failed for chunk #{idx}: #{inspect(reason)}")
                :telemetry.execute([:readaloud, :tts, :transcription_failure], %{count: 1}, %{})
                []
            end

          # Strip WAV header from subsequent chunks before concatenation
          raw_audio =
            if audio_acc == <<>> do
              chunk_audio
            else
              strip_wav_header(chunk_audio)
            end

          new_audio = audio_acc <> raw_audio

          {:cont, {:ok, new_audio, timings_acc ++ chunk_timings, offset_ms + chunk_duration_ms}}

        {:error, reason} ->
          emit_chunk_stop(chunk_started, "error")
          {:halt, {:error, "TTS failed on chunk #{idx}/#{total}: #{inspect(reason)}"}}
      end
    end)
    |> case do
      {:ok, audio, timings, _offset} ->
        # Fix the WAV header to reflect total size
        fixed_audio = fix_wav_header(audio)
        {:ok, fixed_audio, timings}

      {:error, _} = error ->
        error
    end
  end

  defp emit_chunk_stop(started, status) do
    :telemetry.execute(
      [:readaloud, :tts, :chunk, :stop],
      %{duration: System.monotonic_time() - started},
      %{status: status}
    )
  end

  defp strip_wav_header(wav) do
    # Standard WAV header is 44 bytes
    case wav do
      <<"RIFF", _::binary-size(4), "WAVE", _rest::binary>> ->
        # Find "data" chunk
        find_data_chunk(wav, 12)

      _ ->
        wav
    end
  end

  defp find_data_chunk(wav, offset) when offset >= byte_size(wav), do: wav

  defp find_data_chunk(wav, offset) do
    case binary_part(wav, offset, min(4, byte_size(wav) - offset)) do
      "data" ->
        # Skip chunk ID (4) + chunk size (4) = 8 bytes
        data_start = offset + 8
        binary_part(wav, data_start, byte_size(wav) - data_start)

      _ ->
        # Skip chunk ID (4), read chunk size (4), skip to next chunk
        if offset + 8 <= byte_size(wav) do
          <<_::binary-size(offset), _id::binary-size(4), size::little-32, _::binary>> = wav
          find_data_chunk(wav, offset + 8 + size)
        else
          wav
        end
    end
  end

  defp fix_wav_header(wav) do
    case wav do
      <<"RIFF", _::little-32, "WAVE", after_wave::binary>> ->
        # Extract all PCM data after the "data" chunk header
        case extract_pcm_data(after_wave, 0) do
          {:ok, pcm_data} -> build_wav(pcm_data)
          :error -> wav
        end

      _ ->
        wav
    end
  end

  defp extract_pcm_data(binary, offset) when offset + 8 > byte_size(binary), do: :error

  defp extract_pcm_data(binary, offset) do
    <<_::binary-size(offset), chunk_id::binary-size(4), chunk_size::little-32, _::binary>> =
      binary

    if chunk_id == "data" do
      # All bytes after this header are PCM (including appended chunks)
      data_start = offset + 8
      {:ok, binary_part(binary, data_start, byte_size(binary) - data_start)}
    else
      extract_pcm_data(binary, offset + 8 + chunk_size)
    end
  end

  # Build a complete WAV file from raw PCM data (24kHz, 16-bit, mono)
  defp build_wav(pcm_data) do
    data_size = byte_size(pcm_data)

    <<
      "RIFF",
      36 + data_size::little-32,
      "WAVE",
      "fmt ",
      16::little-32,
      1::little-16,
      1::little-16,
      24_000::little-32,
      48_000::little-32,
      2::little-16,
      16::little-16,
      "data",
      data_size::little-32,
      pcm_data::binary
    >>
  end

  defp strip_html(html) do
    html
    # Drop opaque blocks bodily \u2014 naive tag-strip leaves their text content
    # behind (e.g. Reverend Insanity's source injected an h12-media ad
    # <script> whose JS body got spoken aloud as `window.h12_autoplaced=1;`).
    |> String.replace(~r/<script\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/i, " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/<style\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/i, " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/<iframe\b[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/iframe>/i, " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/<[^>]+>/, " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/&[^;]+;/, " ")
    |> String.replace("\u2014", " ")
    |> String.replace("\u2013", " ")
    |> String.replace(~r/\s+/, " ")
    |> String.trim()
  end

  defp audio_storage_path(chapter) do
    base = System.get_env("STORAGE_PATH", "priv/static/files")
    padded = String.pad_leading("#{chapter.number}", 3, "0")
    Path.join([base, "books", "#{chapter.book_id}", "chapters", "#{padded}.wav"])
  end

  defp calculate_duration(wav_bytes) do
    # 24kHz, 16-bit mono
    byte_size(wav_bytes) / (24_000 * 2)
  end
end
defmodule ReadaloudAudiobook do
  alias ReadaloudAudiobook.{AudiobookTask, ChapterAudio, GenerateJob}
  alias ReadaloudLibrary.{Repo, Tasks, TtsProfile}
  alias ReadaloudLibrary.Tasks.Query, as: TaskQuery
  import Ecto.Query

  @max_attempts 3

  def generate_for_chapter(book_id, chapter_id, opts \\ []) do
    attrs =
      %{book_id: book_id, chapter_id: chapter_id}
      |> maybe_put(:voice, Keyword.get(opts, :voice))
      |> maybe_put(:speed, Keyword.get(opts, :speed))
      |> maybe_put(:model, Keyword.get(opts, :model))
      |> maybe_put(:attempt_number, Keyword.get(opts, :attempt_number))

    case %AudiobookTask{} |> AudiobookTask.changeset(attrs) |> Repo.insert() do
      {:ok, task} ->
        job_opts =
          case Keyword.get(opts, :priority) do
            nil -> []
            p -> [priority: p]
          end

        %{"task_id" => task.id}
        |> GenerateJob.new(job_opts)
        |> Oban.insert()

        {:ok, task}

      error ->
        error
    end
  end

  def ensure_audio_generated(book, chapters, progress \\ nil) do
    if TtsProfile.empty?(book.audio_preferences) do
      {:ok, 0}
    else
      do_ensure_audio_generated(book, chapters, progress)
    end
  end

  defp do_ensure_audio_generated(book, chapters, progress) do
    %TtsProfile{model: model, voice: voice} = book.audio_preferences
    chapter_ids = Enum.map(chapters, & &1.id)
    current_number = current_chapter_number(chapters, progress)

    # Load existing state
    audios = list_chapter_audio_for_chapters(chapter_ids)
    tasks = list_tasks_for_chapters(chapter_ids)

    # Index by chapter_id for fast lookup
    audio_by_chapter = Map.new(audios, &{&1.chapter_id, &1})

    pending_chapter_ids =
      tasks
      |> Enum.filter(&Tasks.active?/1)
      |> Enum.map(& &1.chapter_id)
      |> MapSet.new()

    failed_by_chapter = failed_tasks_by_chapter(tasks, model, voice)

    # Determine which chapters need generation
    to_generate =
      Enum.filter(chapters, fn ch ->
        audio = Map.get(audio_by_chapter, ch.id)
        has_pending = MapSet.member?(pending_chapter_ids, ch.id)
        failed_task = Map.get(failed_by_chapter, ch.id)

        needs_audio = audio == nil || audio.model != model || audio.voice != voice
        not_in_flight = !has_pending
        not_exhausted = failed_task == nil || failed_task.attempt_number < @max_attempts

        needs_audio && not_in_flight && not_exhausted
      end)

    # Queue generation for each (fire-and-forget)
    Enum.each(to_generate, fn ch ->
      failed_task = Map.get(failed_by_chapter, ch.id)
      attempt = if failed_task, do: failed_task.attempt_number + 1, else: 1

      generate_for_chapter(book.id, ch.id,
        model: model,
        voice: voice,
        attempt_number: attempt,
        priority: chapter_priority(ch.number, current_number)
      )
    end)

    # Re-prioritize already-pending jobs against the current reading position
    # so the queue picks up near-current chapters first.
    reprioritize_pending_jobs(chapters, current_number)

    {:ok, length(to_generate)}
  end

  @doc """
  Updates priority on already-queued Oban jobs based on chapter distance
  from the current reading position. Lower priority value = picked sooner.
  """
  def reprioritize_pending_jobs(_chapters, nil), do: :ok

  def reprioritize_pending_jobs(chapters, current_number) do
    chapter_ids = Enum.map(chapters, & &1.id)
    number_by_chapter_id = Map.new(chapters, &{&1.id, &1.number})

    pending_tasks =
      AudiobookTask
      |> where([t], t.chapter_id in ^chapter_ids)
      |> TaskQuery.pending()
      |> select([t], {t.id, t.chapter_id})
      |> Repo.all()

    pending_tasks
    |> Enum.group_by(
      fn {_task_id, chapter_id} ->
        number_by_chapter_id |> Map.get(chapter_id) |> chapter_priority(current_number)
      end,
      fn {task_id, _chapter_id} -> task_id end
    )
    |> Enum.each(fn {priority, task_ids} ->
      from(j in "oban_jobs",
        where:
          j.state in ["available", "scheduled", "retryable"] and j.queue == "tts" and
            fragment("CAST(json_extract(?, '$.task_id') AS INTEGER)", j.args) in ^task_ids and
            j.priority != ^priority
      )
      |> Repo.update_all(set: [priority: priority])
    end)

    :ok
  end

  defp current_chapter_number(_chapters, nil), do: nil
  defp current_chapter_number(_chapters, %{current_chapter_id: nil}), do: nil

  defp current_chapter_number(chapters, %{current_chapter_id: current_id}) do
    case Enum.find(chapters, &(&1.id == current_id)) do
      nil -> nil
      ch -> ch.number
    end
  end

  defp chapter_priority(_chapter_number, nil), do: 0
  defp chapter_priority(nil, _current_number), do: 5

  defp chapter_priority(chapter_number, current_number) do
    offset = chapter_number - current_number

    cond do
      offset < 0 -> 9
      offset <= 4 -> 0
      offset <= 19 -> 1
      offset <= 49 -> 2
      offset <= 99 -> 3
      true -> 5
    end
  end

  def list_tasks do
    AudiobookTask |> order_by(desc: :inserted_at) |> Repo.all()
  end

  def get_task(id), do: Repo.get(AudiobookTask, id)

  def get_chapter_audio(chapter_id) do
    ChapterAudio |> where(chapter_id: ^chapter_id) |> Repo.one()
  end

  def list_chapter_audio_for_chapters(chapter_ids) when is_list(chapter_ids) do
    ChapterAudio |> where([a], a.chapter_id in ^chapter_ids) |> Repo.all()
  end

  def list_tasks_for_chapters(chapter_ids) when is_list(chapter_ids) do
    AudiobookTask
    |> where([t], t.chapter_id in ^chapter_ids)
    |> TaskQuery.in_progress_or_failed()
    |> Repo.all()
  end

  def failed_tasks_by_chapter(tasks, model, voice) do
    tasks
    |> Enum.filter(&(Tasks.failed?(&1) && &1.model == model && &1.voice == voice))
    |> Enum.group_by(& &1.chapter_id)
    |> Map.new(fn {ch_id, ch_tasks} ->
      {ch_id, Enum.max_by(ch_tasks, & &1.updated_at)}
    end)
  end

  defp maybe_put(map, _key, nil), do: map
  defp maybe_put(map, key, value), do: Map.put(map, key, value)
end
defmodule ReadaloudTTS do
  @moduledoc """
  Text-to-speech and transcription API.

  Consumers work with three value types:

    * `ReadaloudTTS.Voice` — the (model, voice, speed) bundle used for synthesis
    * `ReadaloudTTS.WordTiming` — a word with its start/end offset in the audio
    * `ReadaloudTTS.Catalog.Entry` — a TTS model and the voices it supports

  Example:

      voice = %ReadaloudTTS.Voice{model: "kokoro", voice: "af_heart"}

      with {:ok, audio}   <- ReadaloudTTS.synthesize("Hello world", voice),
           {:ok, timings} <- ReadaloudTTS.transcribe(audio) do
        # audio   :: binary (WAV)
        # timings :: [%ReadaloudTTS.WordTiming{}]
      end

  Provider selection is a test seam. Pass `provider: SomeModule` in the opts
  of any API call to dispatch through a `ReadaloudTTS.Provider` implementation
  other than the default (`ReadaloudTTS.LocalAIProvider`).
  """

  alias ReadaloudTTS.{Catalog, LocalAIProvider, TextChunker, Voice, WordTiming}

  @type result(t) :: {:ok, t} | {:error, term()}

  @spec synthesize(String.t(), Voice.t(), keyword()) :: result(binary())
  def synthesize(text, %Voice{model: model, voice: voice_id} = voice, opts \\ [])
      when is_binary(text) and is_binary(model) and is_binary(voice_id) do
    provider(opts).synthesize(text, voice, opts)
  end

  @spec transcribe(binary(), keyword()) :: result([WordTiming.t()])
  def transcribe(audio, opts \\ []) when is_binary(audio) do
    provider(opts).transcribe(audio, opts)
  end

  @doc """
  Longest text to send in one `synthesize/3` call for this voice. Models
  that hold a steady delivery only over short requests ask for less than
  the `ReadaloudTTS.TextChunker` default.
  """
  @spec max_chunk_chars(Voice.t(), keyword()) :: pos_integer()
  def max_chunk_chars(%Voice{} = voice, opts \\ []) do
    provider(opts).max_chunk_chars(voice) || TextChunker.default_max_chars()
  end

  @spec catalog(keyword()) :: result([Catalog.Entry.t()])
  def catalog(opts \\ []) do
    provider(opts).catalog(opts)
  end

  defp provider(opts), do: Keyword.get(opts, :provider, LocalAIProvider)
end
defmodule ReadaloudTTS.TextChunker do
  @moduledoc """
  Splits long text into chunks at natural boundaries for TTS processing.

  Ported from monorepo ep-tts TextChunker. Tries split points in order:
  sentence end > semicolon/colon > comma > whitespace.
  """

  @default_max_chars 1500

  @split_patterns [
    ~r/[.!?]["'\x{201d}\x{2019})\]]*\s+/u,
    ~r/[;:]\s+/,
    ~r/,\s+/,
    ~r/\s+/
  ]

  def default_max_chars, do: @default_max_chars

  def chunk(text, max_chars \\ @default_max_chars) do
    case String.trim(text) do
      "" ->
        []

      trimmed ->
        if String.length(trimmed) <= max_chars do
          [trimmed]
        else
          do_chunk(trimmed, max_chars, [])
        end
    end
  end

  defp do_chunk("", _max_chars, acc), do: Enum.reverse(acc)

  defp do_chunk(remaining, max_chars, acc) do
    remaining = String.trim(remaining)

    if String.length(remaining) <= max_chars do
      Enum.reverse([remaining | acc])
    else
      window = String.slice(remaining, 0, max_chars)

      case find_split_point(window) do
        nil ->
          # No split point at all (no whitespace) — force split at limit
          do_chunk(
            String.slice(remaining, max_chars, String.length(remaining)) |> String.trim(),
            max_chars,
            [String.trim(window) | acc]
          )

        split_pos ->
          chunk = String.slice(remaining, 0, split_pos) |> String.trim()
          rest = String.slice(remaining, split_pos, String.length(remaining)) |> String.trim()
          do_chunk(rest, max_chars, [chunk | acc])
      end
    end
  end

  defp find_split_point(text) do
    Enum.find_value(@split_patterns, fn pattern ->
      case Regex.scan(pattern, text, return: :index) do
        [] ->
          nil

        matches ->
          # Take the last match (furthest into the text = largest chunk)
          [{byte_start, byte_len}] = List.last(matches)
          byte_pos = byte_start + byte_len
          # Convert byte offset to grapheme count (Regex returns byte indices,
          # but String.slice uses grapheme indices)
          binary_part(text, 0, byte_pos) |> String.length()
      end
    end)
  end
end
defmodule ReadaloudTTS.Voice do
  @enforce_keys [:model, :voice]
  defstruct [:model, :voice, speed: 1.0]

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          model: String.t(),
          voice: String.t(),
          speed: float()
        }
end
defmodule ReadaloudTTS.Provider do
  alias ReadaloudTTS.{Catalog, Voice, WordTiming}

  @callback synthesize(text :: String.t(), voice :: Voice.t(), opts :: keyword()) ::
              {:ok, binary()} | {:error, term()}

  @callback transcribe(audio :: binary(), opts :: keyword()) ::
              {:ok, [WordTiming.t()]} | {:error, term()}

  @callback catalog(opts :: keyword()) ::
              {:ok, [Catalog.Entry.t()]} | {:error, term()}

  @doc "Longest text, in characters, to send in one synthesis request; nil for no preference."
  @callback max_chunk_chars(voice :: Voice.t()) :: pos_integer() | nil
end

---
name: readaloud-deployment
description: Readaloud deployed on pylon as native NixOS module via configs flake input, data at /var/lib/readaloud/data
type: project
---

Readaloud migrated from Docker Compose to native NixOS module on 2026-03-13.

**Why:** Docker Compose wrapper was fragile — git-pull-on-restart, build-on-deploy, root user, bash secret injection. NixOS module provides reproducible builds, systemd hardening, dedicated user, LoadCredential secrets.

**How to apply:**
- configs repo has `readaloud` flake input (github:ngngardner/readaloud)
- To update readaloud on pylon: push to readaloud repo, then in configs: `nix flake lock --update-input readaloud && nix run .#colmena -- apply --on pylon`
- Data at `/var/lib/readaloud/data` (dataDir matches old Docker volume paths)
- Service runs as `readaloud` user, not root
- LocalAI for TTS runs on phanteks:8090 (Docker container `localai`)

Notebooks: `readaloud-notebooks-sync.timer` on pylon (daily, ~00:10 UTC +

`"<Book> — <Chapter title>"`, one notebook per book). Spec/plan:
`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-19-readaloud-notebooks-sync-design.md`,
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-19-readaloud-notebooks-sync.md` in configs.
So `ask` / Notebooks `search` / the `notebooksRelevant` UserPromptSubmit
injection hook all see novel text with chapter-level citations.

**Why:** Noah's readaloud copy is the authoritative source for web-novel
questions; Notebooks/web only had thin fandom-wiki coverage.

**How to apply:**
- Backfill state: Shadow Slave (book 22, 2721 chapters) fully mirrored on
  2026-08-19 into notebook "Shadow Slave" (`2c72aa5f-1c34-40c2-a5a6-5e0fd25743f6`).
  The other ~18 novels drip in at 15 MB/run (~2 weeks total). Books already
  present as `library`/`notebooks` sources (Fukuoka, JADAM, Miyawaki, Unsouled,
  Tree Crops, …) are deliberately skipped — library copy stays canonical.
- Manual run / status (as root on pylon):
  `sudo -u readaloud readaloud-notebooks-sync --dry-run` (whole library plan),
  `--book <id> --max-bytes 20000000` (force one book now), `journalctl -u readaloud-notebooks-sync`.
- Text is passed through a Python port of readaloud's `Watermark.strip`
  (`scripts/watermark.py`) — scraper homoglyph ads are removed before hashing,
  so don't "fix" junk-looking tokens by hand; a changed chapter re-embeds via
  delete+create.
- Notebooks Postgres grows ~45 MB per MB of text; full backfill ≈ +20–25 GB on
  pylon `/var/lib/notebooks` (140 GB free at start). Watch `df` weekly.
- Rollback caveat: readaloud rows must be deleted before rolling notebooks back
  to a schema without `'readaloud'` in `sources_origin_kind_chk`.

  file — quoting through ssh mangles literals). File number ≠ displayed
  chapter number (file 1316 = "Chapter 1309").

name: project_tts_trial_2026_10
description: "Oct 2026 TTS bake-off vs Kokoro af_heart on readaloud passages — Ming-3.0, Breeze TTS 2, Voxtral; speeds on 3060, audio.cpp as the deploy path"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 91a41bb8-9005-42be-b1cc-00231aeda37e
  modified: 2026-10-22T23:54:14.088Z
---

On 2026-10-22, Noah picked Ming-3.0-tts-0.5B, Breeze TTS 2 and Voxtral TTS from a leaderboard shortlist to compare against readaloud's Kokoro af_heart. Comparison page: https://claude.ai/artifact/BPTph1wS1YtiuZMVgZK6Vn. The scratch work, including weights, venvs and the audio.cpp binary, is in session scratchpad `.../91a41bb8-.../scratchpad/tts/` and may be gone.

**Findings on one RTX 3060** (RTF = generation time divided by audio length):
- Kokoro (GPU): 0.016.
- Voxtral BF16 via audio.cpp: 0.51, 8.2 GB.
- Breeze Q8 via audio.cpp: 0.56, 3.8 GB.
- Ming (PyTorch): 1.03, 2.9 GB.
- Breeze reference PyTorch, eager: 1.9, 8.2 GB. Its fast path needs 14 GB.
- Whisper WER was 3–4.5% for every model, so it doesn't separate them. UTMOS saturates near 4.2–4.5, with Kokoro at the top.
- Drama 3 (35B MoE, #1 open model) doesn't fit on the cards.

**Deploy path:** the audio.cpp release ships GGUFs for Breeze, Voxtral, Fish S2 Pro, Higgs v3 and others, and LocalAI already has an `audio-cpp` backend. The audio.cpp cuda12.8 binary runs on driver 555 (CUDA 12.5) once pip `nvidia-*-cu12` libs are on LD_LIBRARY_PATH. Voxtral's open weights can't clone voices; they only have 20 presets. Ming has no ggml port.

**Pending:** Noah's listening verdict, and which model, if any, goes into LocalAI and readaloud. Related: [[project_localai_nvml_lost_gpu]].

**Breeze chunk seams (Noah: "nice within a passage but not consistent at passage boundaries").** Each chunk samples its delivery fresh at temperature 0.9, so pitch and energy jump at joins: 2.3 semitones on average versus Kokoro's 1.4, with a worst case of 7.9. Seam test page: https://claude.ai/artifact/GDESZnTjSMBqsB8LQeFL7V.
- Best fix measured (3 seeds): temperature 0.6 plus a reference made of a fixed Breeze-generated anchor clip followed by the previous chunk. This gives a worst seam of 3.8 st, better than Kokoro, and passage-to-passage match of 0.956.

Merge target first: `voice-refs` is a branch of the readaloud repo (`/home/noah/projects/readaloud`), so it would merge into readaloud's `master`.

It isn't ready to use in readaloud yet. Everything we built lives in `tools/voice-refs/`, a standalone Python tool that made the comparison page. Readaloud's generator doesn't call it: `GenerateJob` still sends every 400-character chunk with the single `heath-miller` clip. Merging alone wouldn't change what you hear.

Where Reverend Insanity stands now: you're on Chapter 959, which is number 210 in readaloud. Heath Miller audio exists for numbers 179–550. 1,034 more chapters (552–1585) are queued, still with the old single clip.

Wiring it in takes three pieces:

1. **Planner (Python, on phanteks).** For each chapter it would:
   - split the text into passages;
   - have bonsai tag the speaker, sex and mood, and pick a matched clip;
   - apply the name respellings and word fixes;
   - write one plan file per chapter into readaloud's data folder on pylon.

   Later chapters bring new Chinese names, so the planner would respell new names automatically from their pinyin. That can't use the listen-and-check step, because it's too slow to run for every name.
2. **Readaloud.**
   - Add a new voice, "heath-miller (matched)". `GenerateJob` would read the chapter's plan and speak each passage with its own clip at temperature 0.6.
   - Word highlighting would still follow the original text. "Fung Jyo Guhh" is spoken, but "Feng Jiu Ge" is what gets highlighted.
   - A chapter with no plan waits instead of falling back.
3. **Deploy and queue.**
   - Push readaloud, update the configs flake and deploy to pylon.
   - Switch Reverend Insanity to the new voice and cancel the 1,034 old-clip jobs.
   - Queue from 210 onward, skipping chapters before it. Those keep their current audio.

There's one cost you should decide on. Bonsai and the gameassets tagger can't run at the same time, so the tagger timers stay paused whenever the planner runs. My recommendation:
- Plan the next ~100 chapters first so generation can start quickly.
- Then plan the remaining ~1,275 in later runs.
- Restart the tagger after each run.

Once it's running I'll measure how long a chapter takes to plan, so you'll know how long each pause lasts.

Should I build it this way? If yes, I'll merge `voice-refs` into `master`, build the integration on top, and deploy it.

"""voicerefs: one subcommand per pipeline stage. Every stage reads/writes under WORK_DIR."""

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

from . import audio, bonsai, chapter, clusters, laya_check, library, names, page, proofread, textunits, tts, whisper
from .config import FALLBACK_REF, MATCHED_TEMPERATURE, SOURCE_BOOK, VOICES_DIR, WORK_DIR

PIECE_S = 600


def cmd_source(args) -> None:
    out_dir = WORK_DIR / "source"
    pieces_dir = out_dir / "pieces"
    pieces_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    all_segments = []
    for stretch in args.stretches.split(","):
        start, dur = (float(x) for x in stretch.split(":"))
        t = start
        while t < start + dur:
            piece_dur = min(PIECE_S, start + dur - t)
            cache = pieces_dir / f"{int(t):06d}.json"
            if cache.exists():
                segs = [whisper.Segment(**s) for s in json.loads(cache.read_text())]
            else:
                wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, t, piece_dur, pieces_dir / f"{int(t):06d}.wav")
                segs = whisper.transcribe(wav, offset_s=t)
                cache.write_text(json.dumps([asdict(s) for s in segs]))
                wav.unlink()
            print(f"{int(t)}s: {len(segs)} segments", flush=True)
            all_segments.extend(segs)
            t += piece_dur
    (out_dir / "segments.json").write_text(json.dumps([asdict(s) for s in all_segments]))
    print(f"wrote {len(all_segments)} segments")


SOURCE_CONTEXT = (
    "The lines are a Whisper transcript of the audiobook He Who Fights with Monsters, read by one male "
    "narrator who does character voices. Quotation marks are missing, so decide from the wording and "
    "attributions whether a line is spoken dialogue. A line may mix narration and speech; tag it by what "
    "most of it is. Main characters include Jason (male), Farrah (female), Rufus (male), Gary (male), "
    "Clive (male), Humphrey (male), Sophie (female), Belinda (female), Danielle (female), Neil (male)."
)


def cmd_tag_source(args) -> None:
    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    segments = json.loads((src / "segments.json").read_text())
    tags = bonsai.tag_units([s["text"] for s in segments], SOURCE_CONTEXT)
    for seg, tag in zip(segments, tags):
        seg["tag"] = asdict(tag)
    (src / "tagged.json").write_text(json.dumps(segments))
    counts: dict[tuple, int] = {}
    for t in tags:
        key = (t.kind, t.sex, t.mood)
        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    for key, n in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(n, *key)


PAD_S = 0.12
MAX_TRIES = 40
MIN_CLIP_S = 4.5
AGREEMENT_MIN = 0.85
ACTION_MIN = 0.7
SAMPLE_LINES = 15


def _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, pros, intense) -> list[dict]:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    out = []
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    for cid in sorted({x for x in labels if x}):
        idx = np.flatnonzero(lab == cid)
        near = idx[np.argsort(dist[idx])][:SAMPLE_LINES]
        p = pros[idx].mean(axis=0)
        out.append({
            "id": cid, "group": cid.rsplit("-", 1)[0], "segments": int(len(idx)),
            "audio_intensity": round(float(intense[idx].mean()), 2),
            "sound": {"pitch_semitones_re_100hz": round(float(p[0]), 1), "pitch_range_st": round(float(p[1]), 1),
                      "loudness_dbfs": round(float(p[2]), 1), "words_per_second": round(float(p[4]), 2)},
            "moods": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["mood"] for i in idx).most_common(4)),
            "speakers": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["speaker"] for i in idx).most_common(5)),
            "lines": [tagged[i]["text"] for i in near],
        })
    return out


def cmd_cluster(args) -> None:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    tagged = json.loads((src / "tagged.json").read_text())
    feats = np.load(src / "features.npz")
    X = clusters.voice_space(feats["emb"], np.load(src / "emb-egemma.npy"))
    scores = clusters.probe_scores(X, tagged)
    ok = clusters.confident(tagged, scores)
    groups = [clusters.group_of(t["tag"]) for t in tagged]
    print("confident segments per group:", dict(Counter(g for g, o in zip(groups, ok) if o and g)),
          "of", dict(Counter(g for g in groups if g)))
    labels = clusters.subclusters(X, groups, ok, min_size=args.min_size, max_k=args.max_k)
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    dist = np.full(len(X), 99.0)
    for cid in set(labels) - {None}:
        idx = lab == cid
        dist[idx] = np.linalg.norm(X[idx] - X[idx].mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    summaries = _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, feats["pros"], scores["intense"])
    names_by_id = clusters.label_clusters(summaries)
    for sm in summaries:
        lab_ = names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        print(f"{sm['id']:>12} {sm['segments']:5d}  {lab_['label']}  |  {lab_['description']}")

    for seg, cid, d in zip(tagged, labels, dist):
        seg["cluster"], seg["centrality"] = cid, float(d)
    cands = library.candidates(tagged, key=lambda s: (s["cluster"], s["tag"]["speaker"]) if s["cluster"] else None)
    for c in cands:
        ds = [s["centrality"] for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end]
        c.centrality = float(np.mean(ds)) if ds else 99.0
    cut_dir = WORK_DIR / "library" / "cuts"
    lib: dict[str, list[library.RefClip]] = {}
    VOICES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sm in summaries:
        cid, lab_ = sm["id"], names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        pool = sorted((c for c in cands if c.category == cid), key=lambda c: c.centrality)
        clips = []
        for n, c in enumerate(pool[:MAX_TRIES]):
            words = [tuple(w) for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end for w in s["words"]]
            trimmed = library.trim_to_sentences(words)
            if trimmed is None or trimmed[1] - trimmed[0] < MIN_CLIP_S:
                continue
            c.start, c.end, c.text = trimmed
            wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, c.start - PAD_S, c.end - c.start + 2 * PAD_S, cut_dir / f"{cid}-{n}.wav")
            samples, rate = audio.read(wav)
            if not library.signal_ok(samples, rate):
                continue
            heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(wav))
            score = library.word_agreement(c.text, heard)
            if score < AGREEMENT_MIN or not library.whole_sentences(heard):
                continue
            if not cid.startswith("narration") and (library.has_attribution(heard) or not bonsai.pure_speech(heard)):
                continue
            name = f"hwfwm-{cid}-{len(clips)}.wav"
            audio.write(VOICES_DIR / name, samples, rate)
            (VOICES_DIR / name).with_suffix(".txt").write_text(heard)
            clips.append(library.RefClip(lab_["label"], name, heard, c.speaker, c.start, c.end, score=score))
            if len(clips) >= args.per_cluster:
                break
        lib[cid] = clips
        print(f"{cid}: {len(pool)} candidates, {len(clips)} clips" + (f" e.g. {clips[0].transcript[:70]!r}" if clips else ""))
    library.save_library(lib, WORK_DIR / "library.json")
    (WORK_DIR / "clusters.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"labels": names_by_id, "groups": {sm["id"]: sm["group"] for sm in summaries},
         "sizes": {sm["id"]: sm["segments"] for sm in summaries}, "summaries": summaries},
        ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    (src / "clustered.json").write_text(json.dumps(tagged))


CHAPTER_CONTEXT = (
    "The lines are from Reverend Insanity, a Chinese web novel in English translation. Characters are "
    "referred to by Chinese names (e.g. Fang Yuan is male, Hei Lou Lan is female, Hei Cheng is male, "
    "Blazing Heaven Demoness is female)."
)
NAMES_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "names" / "reverend-insanity.json"
BOOK_ID = 12


def _chapter_dir(number: int) -> Path:
    return WORK_DIR / f"ch{number:04d}"


def cmd_chapter(args) -> None:
    out = _chapter_dir(args.number)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = f"/var/lib/readaloud/data/files/books/{BOOK_ID}/chapters/{args.number:04d}.html"
    html = subprocess.run(["ssh", "root@pylon", "cat", src], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    (out / "chapter.html").write_text(html)
    paragraphs = textunits.html_to_paragraphs(html)
    units = textunits.split_units(paragraphs)
    tags = bonsai.tag_units([u.text for u in units], CHAPTER_CONTEXT)
    for i, (u, t) in enumerate(zip(units, tags)):
        if t.kind == "narration" and laya_check.ask(laya_check.ACTION, u.text) >= ACTION_MIN:
            tags[i] = bonsai.Tag(t.kind, t.speaker, t.sex, "action")
    passages = chapter.build_passages(units, tags)
    (out / "passages.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"title": paragraphs[0], "passages": [asdict(p) for p in passages]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    for p in passages:
        print(f"{p.idx:3d} {p.category or '-':16s} {p.tag.speaker[:18]:18s} {p.text[:70]!r}")


NAMES_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"names": {"type": "array", "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "hanzi": {"type": "string"}},
        "required": ["name", "hanzi"]}}},
    "required": ["names"],
}
NAMES_SYSTEM = """You prepare a pronunciation list for a narrator reading a Chinese web novel in English translation.
List every Chinese name written in pinyin in the text: people, nicknames, clans, tribes and places, exactly as written (e.g. "Hei Lou Lan", "Fang Yuan", "Huang Er", "Hei" from "Hei tribe"). Skip anything translated into English, such as "Blazing Heaven Demoness", "Verdant Great Sun" or "Spirit Affinity House".
For each, give the Chinese characters (simplified) the name is written with in the original novel."""


def cmd_names(args) -> None:
    from pypinyin import Style, pinyin

    text = "\n".join(textunits.html_to_paragraphs((_chapter_dir(args.number) / "chapter.html").read_text()))
    reply = bonsai.chat_json(NAMES_SYSTEM, text, NAMES_SCHEMA)
    existing = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text()) if NAMES_FILE.exists() else {}
    for entry in reply["names"]:
        name = entry["name"].strip()
        spelled = names.respell(name)
        if not name or name in existing or name not in text or spelled is None:
            continue
        hanzi = entry["hanzi"].strip() if names.hanzi_matches(name, entry["hanzi"].strip()) else ""
        tones = " ".join(r[0] for r in pinyin(hanzi, style=Style.TONE)) if hanzi else " ".join(names.syllables(name))
        existing[name] = {"hanzi": hanzi, "pinyin": tones, "respelling": spelled}
    NAMES_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    NAMES_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sorted(existing.items())), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")
    for name, e in existing.items():
        print(f"{name:16s} {e['hanzi'] or '-':6s} {e['pinyin']:18s} {e['respelling']}")


def _load_passages(number: int) -> list[chapter.Passage]:
    raw = json.loads((_chapter_dir(number) / "passages.json").read_text())["passages"]
    return [chapter.Passage(p["idx"], p["text"], bonsai.Tag(**p["tag"]), p["category"], p.get("cluster"))
            for p in raw]


def cmd_match(args) -> None:
    pj_path = _chapter_dir(args.number) / "passages.json"
    pj = json.loads(pj_path.read_text())
    cl = json.loads((WORK_DIR / "clusters.json").read_text())
    lib = library.load_library(WORK_DIR / "library.json")
    menu = {cid: f"{lab['label']} ({lab['sex']}): {lab['description']}"
            for cid, lab in cl["labels"].items() if lib.get(cid)}
    picks = clusters.assign_clusters([p["text"].strip() for p in pj["passages"]], menu, CHAPTER_CONTEXT)
    usable = {cid: g for cid, g in cl["groups"].items() if lib.get(cid)}
    tags = [p["tag"] for p in pj["passages"]]
    # Enforce groups first so the per-speaker vote only chooses among voices of the right group.
    picks = clusters.one_voice_per_speaker(tags, clusters.enforce_group(tags, picks, usable, cl["sizes"]))
    for p, cid in zip(pj["passages"], picks):
        p["cluster"] = cid
    pj_path.write_text(json.dumps(pj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    for p in pj["passages"]:
        lab = cl["labels"].get(p["cluster"] or "", {}).get("label", "-")
        print(f"{p['idx']:3d} {p['tag']['speaker'][:16]:16s} {lab[:30]:30s} {p['text'].strip()[:50]!r}")


def cmd_generate(args) -> None:
    ch = _chapter_dir(args.number)
    lib_path = WORK_DIR / "library.json"
    lib = library.load_library(lib_path) if lib_path.exists() else {}
    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    name_map = {name: e["respelling"] for name, e in entries.items()}
    if WORDS_FILE.exists():
        name_map.update(json.loads(WORDS_FILE.read_text()))  # misread English words, e.g. feathermen
    methods = args.methods.split(",") if args.methods else tts.METHODS
    if any(m != "current" for m in methods) and not lib:
        raise SystemExit("library.json missing: run `voicerefs cluster` before generating matched methods")
    gen_path = ch / "generation.json"
    gen = json.loads(gen_path.read_text()) if gen_path.exists() else {"passages": {}, "names": {}}
    result = tts.generate(_load_passages(args.number), lib, name_map, ch / "audio", methods=methods,
                          matched_temperature=MATCHED_TEMPERATURE)
    for idx, by_method in result.items():
        gen["passages"].setdefault(idx, {}).update(by_method)
    gen["names"] = tts.generate_names(entries, ch / "audio")
    gen_path.write_text(json.dumps(gen, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    failed = [(i, m) for i, bm in gen["passages"].items() for m, r in bm.items() if "failed" in r]
    print(f"generated {len(gen['passages'])} passages; {len(failed)} failed: {failed}")


def cmd_page(args) -> None:
    out = Path(args.out)
    index = page.build(_chapter_dir(args.number), NAMES_FILE, VOICES_DIR, out,
                       clusters_path=WORK_DIR / "clusters.json", library_path=WORK_DIR / "library.json",
                       words_path=WORDS_FILE)
    files = sorted(p for p in (out / "audio").iterdir())
    total = sum(p.stat().st_size for p in files) + index.stat().st_size
    print(f"{index}  +{len(files)} audio files, {total / 1e6:.1f} MB")


def cmd_features(args) -> None:
    import numpy as np

    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    segments = json.loads((src / "segments.json").read_text())
    starts = sorted(int(p.stem) for p in (src / "pieces").glob("*.json"))
    tmp = WORK_DIR / "features-tmp"
    emb, pros, egem = [], [], []
    encode_egemma = clusters.egemma_encoder()
    loaded: dict[int, tuple] = {}
    for n, seg in enumerate(segments):
        piece = max(s for s in starts if s <= seg["start"])
        if piece not in loaded:
            loaded.clear()
            wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, piece, PIECE_S + 30, tmp / f"{piece}.wav", rate=clusters.ECAPA_RATE)
            loaded[piece] = audio.read(wav)
            wav.unlink()
        samples, rate = loaded[piece]
        clip = samples[int((seg["start"] - piece) * rate): int((seg["end"] - piece) * rate)]
        if len(clip) < rate // 2:
            clip = np.pad(clip, (0, rate // 2 - len(clip)))
        words = len(seg["text"].split())
        emb.append(clusters.embed(clip, rate))
        egem.append(encode_egemma(clip))
        pros.append(np.append(clusters.prosody(clip, rate), words / max(0.5, seg["end"] - seg["start"])))
        if n % 250 == 0:
            print(f"{n}/{len(segments)}", flush=True)
    np.savez(src / "features.npz", emb=np.array(emb), pros=np.array(pros))
    np.save(src / "emb-egemma.npy", np.array(egem))
    print(f"wrote features for {len(segments)} segments")


WORDS_FILE = NAMES_FILE.with_name("reverend-insanity-words.json")


def cmd_names_probe(args) -> None:
    """Pick each name's respelling by ear-proxy: say every variant, keep the syllable spellings Whisper hears as meant."""
    import tempfile

    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    for name, e in entries.items():
        scores = {}
        for v in names.respell_variants(name):
            samples = tts.render(f"{v} nodded slowly.", *FALLBACK_REF, temperature=MATCHED_TEMPERATURE)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav") as tmp:
                audio.write(Path(tmp.name), samples)
                heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(Path(tmp.name)))
            scores[v] = round(names.score_heard(heard, v, name), 3)
        best = names.combine_best(name, scores)
        e["respelling"], e["probe"] = best, scores
        print(f"{name:16s} -> {best:20s} " + "  ".join(f"{v}={sc}" for v, sc in scores.items()), flush=True)
    NAMES_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")


FIX_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"fixes": {"type": "array", "items": {
        "type": "object", "properties": {"word": {"type": "string"}, "fix": {"type": "string"}},
        "required": ["word", "fix"]}}},
    "required": ["fixes"],
}
FIX_SYSTEM = """A text-to-speech voice read a novel aloud and a speech recogniser transcribed the audio. Each line gives the word(s) in the text, what was heard instead, and how often.
For each, decide whether the voice really misread the word (e.g. "feathermen" heard as "fearmen") or the recogniser just spelled it differently (homophones, "grey"/"gray", numbers, a name it doesn't know, a dropped "the").
If it was misread, give fix = a spelling the voice will read correctly, keeping the meaning (e.g. split compounds: "feather men"). Otherwise give fix = the word unchanged."""


def cmd_proofread(args) -> None:
    from collections import Counter

    ch = _chapter_dir(args.number)
    gen = json.loads((ch / "generation.json").read_text())
    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    ignore = {t for n, e in entries.items() for t in proofread._tokens(n + " " + e["respelling"])}
    found: Counter = Counter()
    where: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for idx, by_method in gen["passages"].items():
        rec = by_method.get(args.method)
        if not rec or "file" not in rec:
            continue
        wav = WORK_DIR / "proofread.wav"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(ch / "audio" / rec["file"]), str(wav)], check=True)
        heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(wav))
        for exp, got in proofread.misheard(rec["text"], heard, ignore):
            found[(exp, got)] += 1
            where.setdefault(exp, []).append(idx)
    for (exp, got), n in found.most_common():
        print(f"{n:3d}  {exp!r} heard as {got!r}  (passages {', '.join(sorted(set(where[exp]), key=int))})")
    if not found or not args.fix:
        return
    lines = "\n".join(f"- text: {exp!r}, heard: {got!r}, times: {n}" for (exp, got), n in found.most_common())
    reply = bonsai.chat_json(FIX_SYSTEM, lines, FIX_SCHEMA)
    words = json.loads(WORDS_FILE.read_text()) if WORDS_FILE.exists() else {}
    for f in reply["fixes"]:
        if f["fix"].strip().lower() != f["word"].strip().lower():
            words[f["word"].strip()] = f["fix"].strip()
    WORDS_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sorted(words.items())), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")
    print("word fixes:", words)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="voicerefs")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    p = sub.add_parser("source", help="transcribe stretches of the source audiobook")
    p.add_argument("--stretches", required=True, help="start:duration seconds, comma separated")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_source)
    p = sub.add_parser("tag-source", help="tag source segments with bonsai")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_tag_source)
    p = sub.add_parser("features", help="voice embedding + prosody for every source segment")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_features)
    p = sub.add_parser("cluster", help="cluster source segments by sound, label clusters, cut reference clips")
    p.add_argument("--min-size", type=int, default=40, help="about this many segments per sub-cluster")
    p.add_argument("--max-k", type=int, default=4, help="most sub-clusters per group")
    p.add_argument("--per-cluster", type=int, default=2)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_cluster)
    p = sub.add_parser("match", help="assign each passage of a chapter a voice cluster")
    p.add_argument("--number", type=int, default=195)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_match)
    for name, func, help_ in (("chapter", cmd_chapter, "tag a chapter and build passages"),
                              ("names", cmd_names, "extract the chapter's names into the book's name list")):
        p = sub.add_parser(name, help=help_)
        p.add_argument("--number", type=int, default=195, help="readaloud chapter number (195 = Chapter 944)")
        p.set_defaults(func=func)
    p = sub.add_parser("generate", help="generate passage audio for each method, plus name samples")
    p.add_argument("--number", type=int, default=195)
    p.add_argument("--methods", default="", help="comma separated subset of current,matched,matched_names")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_generate)
    p = sub.add_parser("page", help="build the comparison page")
    p.add_argument("--number", type=int, default=195)
    p.add_argument("--out", default=str(WORK_DIR / "site"))
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_page)
    p = sub.add_parser("names-probe", help="choose name respellings from what Whisper hears")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_names_probe)
    p = sub.add_parser("proofread", help="find words the voice misread in a chapter's audio")
    p.add_argument("--number", type=int, default=195)
    p.add_argument("--method", default="matched_names")
    p.add_argument("--fix", action="store_true", help="ask bonsai for fixes and save them to the word list")
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_proofread)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.func(args)
"""Turn a tagged chapter into passages: one passage per speaker turn, calm narration merged."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from .bonsai import Tag
from .library import category_of
from .textunits import Unit

MAX_NARRATION = 800


@dataclass
class Passage:
    idx: int
    text: str
    tag: Tag
    category: str | None
    cluster: str | None = None


def build_passages(units: list[Unit], tags: list[Tag]) -> list[Passage]:
    passages: list[Passage] = []
    last_para = None
    for unit, tag in zip(units, tags):
        prev = passages[-1] if passages else None
        if prev and prev.tag == tag:
            if unit.para == last_para:
                prev.text += unit.text
                last_para = unit.para
                continue
            if tag.kind == "narration" and len(prev.text) + len(unit.text) + 1 <= MAX_NARRATION:
                prev.text += "\n" + unit.text
                last_para = unit.para
                continue
        passages.append(Passage(len(passages), unit.text, tag, category_of(tag)))
        last_para = unit.para
    return passages

"""voicerefs: one subcommand per pipeline stage. Every stage reads/writes under WORK_DIR."""

import argparse
import json
import subprocess
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

from . import audio, bonsai, chapter, clusters, laya_check, library, names, page, proofread, textunits, tts, whisper
from .config import FALLBACK_REF, MATCHED_TEMPERATURE, SOURCE_BOOK, VOICES_DIR, WORK_DIR

PIECE_S = 600


def cmd_source(args) -> None:
    out_dir = WORK_DIR / "source"
    pieces_dir = out_dir / "pieces"
    pieces_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    all_segments = []
    for stretch in args.stretches.split(","):
        start, dur = (float(x) for x in stretch.split(":"))
        t = start
        while t < start + dur:
            piece_dur = min(PIECE_S, start + dur - t)
            cache = pieces_dir / f"{int(t):06d}.json"
            if cache.exists():
                segs = [whisper.Segment(**s) for s in json.loads(cache.read_text())]
            else:
                wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, t, piece_dur, pieces_dir / f"{int(t):06d}.wav")
                segs = whisper.transcribe(wav, offset_s=t)
                cache.write_text(json.dumps([asdict(s) for s in segs]))
                wav.unlink()
            print(f"{int(t)}s: {len(segs)} segments", flush=True)
            all_segments.extend(segs)
            t += piece_dur
    (out_dir / "segments.json").write_text(json.dumps([asdict(s) for s in all_segments]))
    print(f"wrote {len(all_segments)} segments")


SOURCE_CONTEXT = (
    "The lines are a Whisper transcript of the audiobook He Who Fights with Monsters, read by one male "
    "narrator who does character voices. Quotation marks are missing, so decide from the wording and "
    "attributions whether a line is spoken dialogue. A line may mix narration and speech; tag it by what "
    "most of it is. Main characters include Jason (male), Farrah (female), Rufus (male), Gary (male), "
    "Clive (male), Humphrey (male), Sophie (female), Belinda (female), Danielle (female), Neil (male)."
)


def cmd_tag_source(args) -> None:
    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    segments = json.loads((src / "segments.json").read_text())
    tags = bonsai.tag_units([s["text"] for s in segments], SOURCE_CONTEXT)
    for seg, tag in zip(segments, tags):
        seg["tag"] = asdict(tag)
    (src / "tagged.json").write_text(json.dumps(segments))
    counts: dict[tuple, int] = {}
    for t in tags:
        key = (t.kind, t.sex, t.mood)
        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    for key, n in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(n, *key)


PAD_S = 0.12
MAX_TRIES = 40
MIN_CLIP_S = 4.5
AGREEMENT_MIN = 0.85
ACTION_MIN = 0.7
SAMPLE_LINES = 15


def _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, pros, intense) -> list[dict]:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    out = []
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    for cid in sorted({x for x in labels if x}):
        idx = np.flatnonzero(lab == cid)
        near = idx[np.argsort(dist[idx])][:SAMPLE_LINES]
        p = pros[idx].mean(axis=0)
        out.append({
            "id": cid, "group": cid.rsplit("-", 1)[0], "segments": int(len(idx)),
            "audio_intensity": round(float(intense[idx].mean()), 2),
            "sound": {"pitch_semitones_re_100hz": round(float(p[0]), 1), "pitch_range_st": round(float(p[1]), 1),
                      "loudness_dbfs": round(float(p[2]), 1), "words_per_second": round(float(p[4]), 2)},
            "moods": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["mood"] for i in idx).most_common(4)),
            "speakers": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["speaker"] for i in idx).most_common(5)),
            "lines": [tagged[i]["text"] for i in near],
        })
    return out


def cmd_cluster(args) -> None:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    tagged = json.loads((src / "tagged.json").read_text())
    feats = np.load(src / "features.npz")
    X = clusters.voice_space(feats["emb"], np.load(src / "emb-egemma.npy"))
    scores = clusters.probe_scores(X, tagged)
    ok = clusters.confident(tagged, scores)
    groups = [clusters.group_of(t["tag"]) for t in tagged]
    print("confident segments per group:", dict(Counter(g for g, o in zip(groups, ok) if o and g)),
          "of", dict(Counter(g for g in groups if g)))
    labels = clusters.subclusters(X, groups, ok, min_size=args.min_size, max_k=args.max_k)
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    dist = np.full(len(X), 99.0)
    for cid in set(labels) - {None}:
        idx = lab == cid
        dist[idx] = np.linalg.norm(X[idx] - X[idx].mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    summaries = _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, feats["pros"], scores["intense"])
    names_by_id = clusters.label_clusters(summaries)
    for sm in summaries:
        lab_ = names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        print(f"{sm['id']:>12} {sm['segments']:5d}  {lab_['label']}  |  {lab_['description']}")

    for seg, cid, d in zip(tagged, labels, dist):
        seg["cluster"], seg["centrality"] = cid, float(d)
    cands = library.candidates(tagged, key=lambda s: (s["cluster"], s["tag"]["speaker"]) if s["cluster"] else None)
    for c in cands:
        ds = [s["centrality"] for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end]
        c.centrality = float(np.mean(ds)) if ds else 99.0
    cut_dir = WORK_DIR / "library" / "cuts"
    lib: dict[str, list[library.RefClip]] = {}
    VOICES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sm in summaries:
        cid, lab_ = sm["id"], names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        pool = sorted((c for c in cands if c.category == cid), key=lambda c: c.centrality)
        clips = []
        for n, c in enumerate(pool[:MAX_TRIES]):
            words = [tuple(w) for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end for w in s["words"]]
            trimmed = library.trim_to_sentences(words)
            if trimmed is None or trimmed[1] - trimmed[0] < MIN_CLIP_S:
                continue
            c.start, c.end, c.text = trimmed
            wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, c.start - PAD_S, c.end - c.start + 2 * PAD_S, cut_dir / f"{cid}-{n}.wav")
            samples, rate = audio.read(wav)
            if not library.signal_ok(samples, rate):
                continue
            heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(wav))
            score = library.word_agreement(c.text, heard)
            if score < AGREEMENT_MIN or not library.whole_sentences(heard):
                continue
            if not cid.startswith("narration") and (library.has_attribution(heard) or not bonsai.pure_speech(heard)):
                continue
            name = f"hwfwm-{cid}-{len(clips)}.wav"
            audio.write(VOICES_DIR / name, samples, rate)
            (VOICES_DIR / name).with_suffix(".txt").write_text(heard)
            clips.append(library.RefClip(lab_["label"], name, heard, c.speaker, c.start, c.end, score=score))
            if len(clips) >= args.per_cluster:
                break
        lib[cid] = clips
        print(f"{cid}: {len(pool)} candidates, {len(clips)} clips" + (f" e.g. {clips[0].transcript[:70]!r}" if clips else ""))
    library.save_library(lib, WORK_DIR / "library.json")
    (WORK_DIR / "clusters.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"labels": names_by_id, "groups": {sm["id"]: sm["group"] for sm in summaries},
         "sizes": {sm["id"]: sm["segments"] for sm in summaries}, "summaries": summaries},
        ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    (src / "clustered.json").write_text(json.dumps(tagged))


CHAPTER_CONTEXT = (
    "The lines are from Reverend Insanity, a Chinese web novel in English translation. Characters are "
    "referred to by Chinese names (e.g. Fang Yuan is male, Hei Lou Lan is female, Hei Cheng is male, "
    "Blazing Heaven Demoness is female)."
)
NAMES_FILE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "names" / "reverend-insanity.json"
BOOK_ID = 12


def _chapter_dir(number: int) -> Path:
    return WORK_DIR / f"ch{number:04d}"


def cmd_chapter(args) -> None:
    out = _chapter_dir(args.number)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    src = f"/var/lib/readaloud/data/files/books/{BOOK_ID}/chapters/{args.number:04d}.html"
    html = subprocess.run(["ssh", "root@pylon", "cat", src], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    (out / "chapter.html").write_text(html)
    paragraphs = textunits.html_to_paragraphs(html)
    units = textunits.split_units(paragraphs)
    tags = bonsai.tag_units([u.text for u in units], CHAPTER_CONTEXT)
    for i, (u, t) in enumerate(zip(units, tags)):
        if t.kind == "narration" and laya_check.ask(laya_check.ACTION, u.text) >= ACTION_MIN:
            tags[i] = bonsai.Tag(t.kind, t.speaker, t.sex, "action")
    passages = chapter.build_passages(units, tags)
    (out / "passages.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"title": paragraphs[0], "passages": [asdict(p) for p in passages]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    for p in passages:
        print(f"{p.idx:3d} {p.category or '-':16s} {p.tag.speaker[:18]:18s} {p.text[:70]!r}")


NAMES_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {"names": {"type": "array", "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "hanzi": {"type": "string"}},
        "required": ["name", "hanzi"]}}},
    "required": ["names"],
}
NAMES_SYSTEM = """You prepare a pronunciation list for a narrator reading a Chinese web novel in English translation.
List every Chinese name written in pinyin in the text: people, nicknames, clans, tribes and places, exactly as written (e.g. "Hei Lou Lan", "Fang Yuan", "Huang Er", "Hei" from "Hei tribe"). Skip anything translated into English, such as "Blazing Heaven Demoness", "Verdant Great Sun" or "Spirit Affinity House".
For each, give the Chinese characters (simplified) the name is written with in the original novel."""


def cmd_names(args) -> None:
    from pypinyin import Style, pinyin

    text = "\n".join(textunits.html_to_paragraphs((_chapter_dir(args.number) / "chapter.html").read_text()))
    reply = bonsai.chat_json(NAMES_SYSTEM, text, NAMES_SCHEMA)
    existing = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text()) if NAMES_FILE.exists() else {}
    for entry in reply["names"]:
        name = entry["name"].strip()
        spelled = names.respell(name)
        if not name or name in existing or name not in text or spelled is None:
            continue
        hanzi = entry["hanzi"].strip() if names.hanzi_matches(name, entry["hanzi"].strip()) else ""
        tones = " ".join(r[0] for r in pinyin(hanzi, style=Style.TONE)) if hanzi else " ".join(names.syllables(name))
        existing[name] = {"hanzi": hanzi, "pinyin": tones, "respelling": spelled}
    NAMES_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    NAMES_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sorted(existing.items())), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")
    for name, e in existing.items():
        print(f"{name:16s} {e['hanzi'] or '-':6s} {e['pinyin']:18s} {e['respelling']}")


def _load_passages(number: int) -> list[chapter.Passage]:

            for p in raw]


def cmd_match(args) -> None:
    pj_path = _chapter_dir(args.number) / "passages.json"
    pj = json.loads(pj_path.read_text())
    cl = json.loads((WORK_DIR / "clusters.json").read_text())
    lib = library.load_library(WORK_DIR / "library.json")
    menu = {cid: f"{lab['label']} ({lab['sex']}): {lab['description']}"
            for cid, lab in cl["labels"].items() if lib.get(cid)}
    picks = clusters.assign_clusters([p["text"].strip() for p in pj["passages"]], menu, CHAPTER_CONTEXT)
    usable = {cid: g for cid, g in cl["groups"].items() if lib.get(cid)}
    tags = [p["tag"] for p in pj["passages"]]
    # Enforce groups first so the per-speaker vote only chooses among voices of the right group.
    picks = clusters.one_voice_per_speaker(tags, clusters.enforce_group(tags, picks, usable, cl["sizes"]))
    for p, cid in zip(pj["passages"], picks):
        p["cluster"] = cid
    pj_path.write_text(json.dumps(pj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    for p in pj["passages"]:
        lab = cl["labels"].get(p["cluster"] or "", {}).get("label", "-")
        print(f"{p['idx']:3d} {p['tag']['speaker'][:16]:16s} {lab[:30]:30s} {p['text'].strip()[:50]!r}")

    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    name_map = {name: e["respelling"] for name, e in entries.items()}
    if WORDS_FILE.exists():
        name_map.update(json.loads(WORDS_FILE.read_text()))  # misread English words, e.g. feathermen
    methods = args.methods.split(",") if args.methods else tts.METHODS
    if any(m != "current" for m in methods) and not lib:
        raise SystemExit("library.json missing: run `voicerefs cluster` before generating matched methods")
    gen_path = ch / "generation.json"

    result = tts.generate(_load_passages(args.number), lib, name_map, ch / "audio", methods=methods,

def cmd_features(args) -> None:
    import numpy as np

    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    segments = json.loads((src / "segments.json").read_text())
    starts = sorted(int(p.stem) for p in (src / "pieces").glob("*.json"))
    tmp = WORK_DIR / "features-tmp"
    emb, pros, egem = [], [], []
    encode_egemma = clusters.egemma_encoder()
    loaded: dict[int, tuple] = {}
    for n, seg in enumerate(segments):
        piece = max(s for s in starts if s <= seg["start"])
        if piece not in loaded:
            loaded.clear()
            wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, piece, PIECE_S + 30, tmp / f"{piece}.wav", rate=clusters.ECAPA_RATE)
            loaded[piece] = audio.read(wav)
            wav.unlink()
        samples, rate = loaded[piece]
        clip = samples[int((seg["start"] - piece) * rate): int((seg["end"] - piece) * rate)]
        if len(clip) < rate // 2:
            clip = np.pad(clip, (0, rate // 2 - len(clip)))
        words = len(seg["text"].split())
        emb.append(clusters.embed(clip, rate))
        egem.append(encode_egemma(clip))
        pros.append(np.append(clusters.prosody(clip, rate), words / max(0.5, seg["end"] - seg["start"])))
        if n % 250 == 0:
            print(f"{n}/{len(segments)}", flush=True)
    np.savez(src / "features.npz", emb=np.array(emb), pros=np.array(pros))
    np.save(src / "emb-egemma.npy", np.array(egem))
    print(f"wrote features for {len(segments)} segments")

def cmd_names_probe(args) -> None:
    """Pick each name's respelling by ear-proxy: say every variant, keep the syllable spellings Whisper hears as meant."""
    import tempfile

    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    for name, e in entries.items():
        scores = {}
        for v in names.respell_variants(name):
            samples = tts.render(f"{v} nodded slowly.", *FALLBACK_REF, temperature=MATCHED_TEMPERATURE)
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".wav") as tmp:
                audio.write(Path(tmp.name), samples)
                heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(Path(tmp.name)))
            scores[v] = round(names.score_heard(heard, v, name), 3)
        best = names.combine_best(name, scores)
        e["respelling"], e["probe"] = best, scores
        print(f"{name:16s} -> {best:20s} " + "  ".join(f"{v}={sc}" for v, sc in scores.items()), flush=True)
    NAMES_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(entries, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")

FIX_SYSTEM = """A text-to-speech voice read a novel aloud and a speech recogniser transcribed the audio. Each line gives the word(s) in the text, what was heard instead, and how often.
For each, decide whether the voice really misread the word (e.g. "feathermen" heard as "fearmen") or the recogniser just spelled it differently (homophones, "grey"/"gray", numbers, a name it doesn't know, a dropped "the").
If it was misread, give fix = a spelling the voice will read correctly, keeping the meaning (e.g. split compounds: "feather men"). Otherwise give fix = the word unchanged."""


def cmd_proofread(args) -> None:
    from collections import Counter

    ch = _chapter_dir(args.number)
    gen = json.loads((ch / "generation.json").read_text())
    entries = json.loads(NAMES_FILE.read_text())
    ignore = {t for n, e in entries.items() for t in proofread._tokens(n + " " + e["respelling"])}
    found: Counter = Counter()
    where: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for idx, by_method in gen["passages"].items():
        rec = by_method.get(args.method)
        if not rec or "file" not in rec:
            continue
        wav = WORK_DIR / "proofread.wav"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(ch / "audio" / rec["file"]), str(wav)], check=True)
        heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(wav))
        for exp, got in proofread.misheard(rec["text"], heard, ignore):
            found[(exp, got)] += 1
            where.setdefault(exp, []).append(idx)
    for (exp, got), n in found.most_common():
        print(f"{n:3d}  {exp!r} heard as {got!r}  (passages {', '.join(sorted(set(where[exp]), key=int))})")
    if not found or not args.fix:
        return
    lines = "\n".join(f"- text: {exp!r}, heard: {got!r}, times: {n}" for (exp, got), n in found.most_common())
    reply = bonsai.chat_json(FIX_SYSTEM, lines, FIX_SCHEMA)
    words = json.loads(WORDS_FILE.read_text()) if WORDS_FILE.exists() else {}
    for f in reply["fixes"]:
        if f["fix"].strip().lower() != f["word"].strip().lower():
            words[f["word"].strip()] = f["fix"].strip()
    WORDS_FILE.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sorted(words.items())), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1) + "\n")
    print("word fixes:", words)

"""Turn a tagged chapter into passages: one passage per speaker turn, calm narration merged."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from .bonsai import Tag
from .library import category_of
from .textunits import Unit

MAX_NARRATION = 800


@dataclass
class Passage:
    idx: int
    text: str
    tag: Tag
    category: str | None
    cluster: str | None = None


def build_passages(units: list[Unit], tags: list[Tag]) -> list[Passage]:
    passages: list[Passage] = []
    last_para = None
    for unit, tag in zip(units, tags):
        prev = passages[-1] if passages else None
        if prev and prev.tag == tag:
            if unit.para == last_para:
                prev.text += unit.text
                last_para = unit.para
                continue
            if tag.kind == "narration" and len(prev.text) + len(unit.text) + 1 <= MAX_NARRATION:
                prev.text += "\n" + unit.text
                last_para = unit.para
                continue
        passages.append(Passage(len(passages), unit.text, tag, category_of(tag)))
        last_para = unit.para
    return passages

def _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, pros, intense) -> list[dict]:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    out = []
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    for cid in sorted({x for x in labels if x}):
        idx = np.flatnonzero(lab == cid)
        near = idx[np.argsort(dist[idx])][:SAMPLE_LINES]
        p = pros[idx].mean(axis=0)
        out.append({
            "id": cid, "group": cid.rsplit("-", 1)[0], "segments": int(len(idx)),
            "audio_intensity": round(float(intense[idx].mean()), 2),
            "sound": {"pitch_semitones_re_100hz": round(float(p[0]), 1), "pitch_range_st": round(float(p[1]), 1),
                      "loudness_dbfs": round(float(p[2]), 1), "words_per_second": round(float(p[4]), 2)},
            "moods": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["mood"] for i in idx).most_common(4)),
            "speakers": dict(Counter(tagged[i]["tag"]["speaker"] for i in idx).most_common(5)),
            "lines": [tagged[i]["text"] for i in near],
        })
    return out


def cmd_cluster(args) -> None:
    import numpy as np
    from collections import Counter

    src = WORK_DIR / "source"
    tagged = json.loads((src / "tagged.json").read_text())
    feats = np.load(src / "features.npz")
    X = clusters.voice_space(feats["emb"], np.load(src / "emb-egemma.npy"))
    scores = clusters.probe_scores(X, tagged)
    ok = clusters.confident(tagged, scores)
    groups = [clusters.group_of(t["tag"]) for t in tagged]
    print("confident segments per group:", dict(Counter(g for g, o in zip(groups, ok) if o and g)),
          "of", dict(Counter(g for g in groups if g)))
    labels = clusters.subclusters(X, groups, ok, min_size=args.min_size, max_k=args.max_k)
    lab = np.array([x or "" for x in labels])
    dist = np.full(len(X), 99.0)
    for cid in set(labels) - {None}:
        idx = lab == cid
        dist[idx] = np.linalg.norm(X[idx] - X[idx].mean(axis=0), axis=1)
    summaries = _summaries(tagged, labels, dist, feats["pros"], scores["intense"])
    names_by_id = clusters.label_clusters(summaries)
    for sm in summaries:
        lab_ = names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        print(f"{sm['id']:>12} {sm['segments']:5d}  {lab_['label']}  |  {lab_['description']}")

    for seg, cid, d in zip(tagged, labels, dist):
        seg["cluster"], seg["centrality"] = cid, float(d)
    cands = library.candidates(tagged, key=lambda s: (s["cluster"], s["tag"]["speaker"]) if s["cluster"] else None)
    for c in cands:
        ds = [s["centrality"] for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end]
        c.centrality = float(np.mean(ds)) if ds else 99.0
    cut_dir = WORK_DIR / "library" / "cuts"
    lib: dict[str, list[library.RefClip]] = {}
    VOICES_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for sm in summaries:
        cid, lab_ = sm["id"], names_by_id[sm["id"]]
        pool = sorted((c for c in cands if c.category == cid), key=lambda c: c.centrality)
        clips = []
        for n, c in enumerate(pool[:MAX_TRIES]):
            words = [tuple(w) for s in tagged if c.start <= s["start"] < c.end for w in s["words"]]
            trimmed = library.trim_to_sentences(words)
            if trimmed is None or trimmed[1] - trimmed[0] < MIN_CLIP_S:
                continue
            c.start, c.end, c.text = trimmed
            wav = audio.extract(SOURCE_BOOK, c.start - PAD_S, c.end - c.start + 2 * PAD_S, cut_dir / f"{cid}-{n}.wav")
            samples, rate = audio.read(wav)
            if not library.signal_ok(samples, rate):
                continue
            heard = " ".join(s.text for s in whisper.transcribe(wav))
            score = library.word_agreement(c.text, heard)
            if score < AGREEMENT_MIN or not library.whole_sentences(heard):
                continue
            if not cid.startswith("narration") and (library.has_attribution(heard) or not bonsai.pure_speech(heard)):
                continue
            name = f"hwfwm-{cid}-{len(clips)}.wav"
            audio.write(VOICES_DIR / name, samples, rate)
            (VOICES_DIR / name).with_suffix(".txt").write_text(heard)
            clips.append(library.RefClip(lab_["label"], name, heard, c.speaker, c.start, c.end, score=score))
            if len(clips) >= args.per_cluster:
                break
        lib[cid] = clips
        print(f"{cid}: {len(pool)} candidates, {len(clips)} clips" + (f" e.g. {clips[0].transcript[:70]!r}" if clips else ""))
    library.save_library(lib, WORK_DIR / "library.json")
    (WORK_DIR / "clusters.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        {"labels": names_by_id, "groups": {sm["id"]: sm["group"] for sm in summaries},
         "sizes": {sm["id"]: sm["segments"] for sm in summaries}, "summaries": summaries},
        ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
    (src / "clustered.json").write_text(json.dumps(tagged))
